title: 'Omar cuts up the royal banqueting carpet of the Chosroes
description: The royal carpet from Al-Medain, seventy cubits by sixty and wrought in gold, silver and jewels, was sent to the Caliph. Most advised keeping it as a trophy of Islam, but 'Ali objected and 'Omar had it cut in pieces and distributed with the other booty; 'Ali's share fetched twenty thousand dirhems (A.H. 15-16). Dated to the year 0637 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A.H. 15-16."
